summary: RAG exemplar topology + champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1
hypothesis: Grafting the RAG-exemplar in-context topology from exp008 onto the best LoRA adapter (v2a_e1) should outperform either ingredient alone, because the adapter's fine-tuned judgment combined with retrieved exemplars ought to compound their individual gains.
technique: A matrix sweep crossing all inference topologies against the best LoRA adapter: here the ragAdaptExemplar in-context topology (raw exp008) is run with the champion adapter v2a_e1 instead of the base model, using greedy decoding, evaluated on the full-30 set.
result: Scored 0.309 on the full-30 greedy gate — above the raw exp008 baseline (0.247) but well below the champion exp056 (0.440). The combination did not compound gains as hoped, and the run was discarded; the hypothesis was falsified.
